title: The Rapid growth of the town
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：rapid　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rapid 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the driver wrote of ① a rapid growth of the town in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② more rapid than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the rapid ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most rapid growth of the town anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1982 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too rapid to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the rapid ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a rapid answer from the office, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as rapid as the answer from the office they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was rapid or not, and he said so.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something rapid, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite rapid; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the rapid ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998, twice over, she wrote of another rapid growth of the town in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more rapid than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most rapid answer from the office in the whole station, she said in 2000, was the one she could never quite name; the rapid ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 迅速（前置定语 a rapid growth of the town：1988 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件迅速的发展）
B. adj. 迅速／快速（比较级 more rapid than：文中两处，一处比小镇的迅速发展，一处比预想）
C. adj. 迅速／快速（最高级 the most rapid：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 迅速（表语 too rapid to do：母亲觉得它太迅速，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 快速（前置定语 a rapid answer from the office：叔叔把整件事称作一桩快速的答复）
F. adj. 快速（同级比较 as rapid as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩办公室迅速的答复相比）
G. adj. 快速（后置定语 something rapid：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 快速（受程度副词修饰 quite rapid：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a rapid growth of the town
the most rapid growth of the town anybody
a rapid answer from the office
The most rapid answer from the office in

answers.why: rapid 意为“迅速”，1988 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件迅速的发展”，此处作前置定语 a rapid growth of the town。
rapid 意为“迅速”，此处用比较级 more rapid than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
rapid 意为“迅速”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说它是车站里最迅速的一件，故用最高级 the most rapid growth of the town。
rapid 意为“迅速”，母亲认为这件东西“太迅速了，谁也用不上”，too rapid to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
rapid 意为“快速”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩快速的答复”，此处作前置定语 a rapid answer from the office。
rapid 意为“快速”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩办公室迅速的答复一样快速”，同级比较用 as rapid as。
rapid 意为“快速”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“快速的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something rapid。
rapid 意为“快速”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当快速”，quite 修饰原级 rapid。
rapid 意为“快速”，1998 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要快速”，故用比较级 more rapid than。
rapid 意为“快速”，母亲 2000 年说的是“整个车站里最快速的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most rapid answer from the office。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件迅速的发展。（a rapid growth of the town）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更迅速。（more rapid than …）
母亲觉得它太迅速，谁也用不上。（too rapid to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩快速的答复。（a rapid answer from the office）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩办公室迅速的答复一样快速。（as rapid as …）
到了 1995 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件快速的东西。（something rapid）
answers: In 1988 the driver wrote of a rapid growth of the town in the timetable.
Everybody said it was more rapid than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too rapid to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a rapid answer from the office.
He said nobody would call it as rapid as the answer from the office they had once had.
By 1995 the timetable asked for nothing but something rapid.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 rapid 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the driver wrote of a rapid growth of the town in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most rapid growth of the town in the station, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too rapid to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a rapid answer from the office, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite rapid, and everybody laughed.
The rapid ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
